Subject: Everleaf Health — launch expectations & steward nomination

Team — handing off Everleaf (closed last week). Quick summary and ask so CS can pick up with momentum.

Deal snapshot:
- SKU: Redwood API (hosted) + Dedicated pool pilot for Q1
- Target go-live (pilot): 2027-02-14 (two-phase: staging integration -> 30-day pilot)
- Committed TPS: ~45 req/sec during peak; will start at 10–15 while ramping
- Sensitive data: PII tokenization requirement; customer will route PHI-containing traffic through our dedicated pool and VPC peering.

Priority asks for CS and implementation team:
1) Steward nomination: who will lead day-to-day implementation and who owns security/compliance evidence collection?
2) Kickoff cadence: propose 1-hour technical kickoff in next 5 business days, plus weekly 30-min syncs for the pilot
3) Integration notes: Everleaf uses an on-prem ETL that will POST to our ingest endpoint; they need a test API key + sample payload by next Tuesday
4) SOW & MAP attached — SOW has acceptance criteria and three milestone dates (see attachment).

Risks / blockers (from me):
- Legal asked for a small data retention tweak; procurement is circulating a redline (cc'ed)
- Everleaf needs SOC2 evidence for the dedicated pool; Monica — can you own the evidence packet?

Attachments:
- [Attachment: everleaf_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 152KB)]
- [Attachment: everleaf_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)]

Next steps I recommend:
- Marissa: lead steward; Tessa: primary implementation PM; Monica: security/compliance POC
- Ben: will remain available as escalation for contract/commits

Thanks — happy to jump on the first kickoff if helpful.

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks Ben — great summary. Confirming I can take stewardship. A few clarifying Qs before we lock owners and schedule kickoff: 

1) Acceptance criteria: SOW lists "performance within SLA for 7 consecutive days" — is the SLA documented in the attachment or do we have a separate perf-spec?
2) Data flow: when you say "PII tokenization", do they intend to tokenize upstream (their ETL) or rely on our prefix/KV caching layer? If upstream, we'll need their developers on the kickoff.
3) Test credentials: can engineering provision the test API key and a staging pool this week? If procurement finalizes the redline late this week, we may need to push the staging window.

I'll tentatively assign owners internally:
- Implementation Lead (primary): Tessa Morgan
- Security/compliance POC: Monica Patel
- Escalation / billing: Ben Carter

Proposed kickoff times (PT) 
- Wed 1/13 11:00–12:00
- Thu 1/14 09:00–10:00
Please confirm availability and I'll send calendar invites + agenda.

Marissa Cole
